title: The Warden’s Last Watch
introduction: Beyond the mountain paths, an old arena lies open to wind and wild growth. At its center, a solitary guardian keeps a torch burning against the quiet.
completionText: The torchlight fades, and the abandoned arena is left to the mountains, the wind, and the returning green.
storySummary: In an abandoned mountain arena, a lone Torch Warden maintained an ancient watch. The warden was defeated, leaving the open ruins to wind and returning growth.
